---
type: C4 System
title: Getro
description: Hosted job-board platform most funds use
status: stable
groma:
  id: getro
  technology: HTTPS, JSON search API and Next.js page data
---

Getro runs the portfolio job boards of about two hundred of the tracked funds. Its public search API lists a board's jobs a page at a time under a shared rate limit, and each job page's Next.js data carries the description and job functions.
